title: Counting Patterns and 10 More/10 Less
description: Count forward by 1s, 2s, 5s, and 10s from different starting numbers, complete number patterns, and find 10 more or 10 less.
learningFocus: Count forward within 120 by 1s, 2s, 5s, and 10s from different starting numbers, identify counting patterns, and mentally find 10 more or 10 less than a two-digit number.
adultGuidance: Ask your child to say each pattern aloud before filling in the blanks and explain how the numbers change from one box to the next. For 10 more or 10 less, encourage them to notice that the ones digit stays the same while the value changes by one ten.

seo.title: Counting Patterns and 10 More/10 Less Worksheets | Grade 1
seo.description: Five printable Grade 1 math worksheets for counting by 1s, 2s, 5s, and 10s, completing number patterns, and finding 10 more or less.
